NodeChanges

class NodeChanges(opinion: float, previous_opinion: float, radicalised: bool, social_weightings: dict[str, float])[source]

Bases: object

Dataclass that stores all the relevant information needed to update GraphNodes in the model’s base graph.

Parameters:

  • opinion (float) – The newest opinion value that the agent in the node should have.

  • previous_opinion (float) – The newest previous_opinion value that the agent in the node should have.

  • radicalised (bool) – The newest radicalisation status that the agent in the node should have.

  • social_weightings (dict[str, float]) – The newest social weightings that the agent in the node should have.
